standard: IEEE 1800-2023 11.4.14.4: unpacking into a list with an unbounded dynamically sized item is greedy, the first such item is resized to accept all the data except the subsequent fixed-size items; 6.24.3 extracts the data in left-to-right order. The 17-byte stream gives o_data 5 bytes and o_crc 42.
